title: opum_active_task returns only the last In Progress task, not all of them
summary: hooks/_lib.sh opum_active_task() pipes quest's single-line minified JSON through 'sed s/.*"id":"(...)".*/\1/p'. The leading .* is greedy, so with N In Progress tasks on one line the substitution matches only the LAST "id" occurrence and returns one id no matter how many tasks are In Progress. flush-state.sh relies on the empty/one-id/two-id-with-space cases to decide whether to write a tracker note; with 3 In Progress tasks it silently picks whichever task's id happened to sort last in the JSON and writes the session note onto it. Found by lore-web, verified by opum-agent against a live quest-cli checkout (In Progress QCLI-196/207/238, function returned only QCLI-238). Reported 2026-09-05.

acceptanceCriteria.text: opum_active_task extracts every "id" occurrence on the line (grep -o, not a single greedy sed substitution), so multiple In Progress tasks are all seen before sort -u/head -2 apply
hooks/test/run-tests.sh gains a fixture with 2+ In Progress tasks on one line asserting the guard withholds (space-joined output, no tracker note written)
hooks/test/run-tests.sh keeps asserting the single-task case still writes a note
.claude-plugin/plugin.json version bumped (hooks changed) and the manifests CI check passes

plan: 2. Fix opum_active_task in hooks/_lib.sh to use grep -o for multi-match extraction

finalSummary: Fixed hooks/_lib.sh opum_active_task(): replaced the single greedy sed substitution (which only ever matched the LAST "id" on quest's one-line minified JSON) with grep -o to extract every "id" occurrence before sort -u/head -2. Added two tests to hooks/test/run-tests.sh: a direct check that 3 In Progress tasks yield two sorted ids (not just the last), and an integration check that flush-state.sh withholds the tracker note and records ambiguity in the cursor. Verified the new tests fail (5 failures) against the pre-fix code and pass (0 failures, 39 total) against the fix. Bumped .claude-plugin/plugin.json to 0.3.1; claude plugin validate . passes.
